title: Aurora N NDE 3077
content: Well the nurse told me to count to ten. It seemed like I had just closed my eyes yet opened them. Like my mind was wide awake. I was going through a dark tunnel. It seemed like a part of me was scared of lying on the bed. I looked left and right but all I could see was the fast speed that I was going through the tunnel then I saw some light at the end of the tunnel. Before I knew it, I was standing there in heaven. I could hear the angels sing in the most beautiful voice one can't imagine. Then I heard the voice of the Lord, like he was in front of the angels and I was trying to go through, but God said it was not my time. But I wanted to go in. Then God said turn and look. (It's a voice you obey.) So I turned and I could see all the doctors there working on me, like when you look out a window and see the full moon so close, I too saw myself. When I turned back to tell the Lord I wanted to stay. I woke-up back in my body; I woke crying, the nurse though I was crying because I had lost my baby. She told me they had lost me for a minute and was glad I was all right. Yes, I cried because I lost my baby later that same day. But I woke crying because I wanted to stay up in heaven with God.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Childbirth 'Baby was dead inside and I was bleeding inside I didn't know what was going on I had very, very bad pain.' Other 'MISCARRIAGE, BLEEDING HEAVY,SEVERE PAIN.'. I was put to sleep by gas - in which the nurse told me I had died for a minute when she woke me up. (I woke up crying because I didn't want to come back.)
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal To me it seem as if I were conscious all through the whole experience.
elements.At what time during the experience were: To me it seem as if I were conscious all through the whole experience.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: In my experience I could see well although there were clouds all around, like you can see better, much better than one's 20/20 vision.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Well you can hear music without a doubt so beautiful like you never hear anything.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I was going through a tunnel at a very fast pace.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I meet with God almighty. However, I didn't see him only a beautiful bright cloud and I could hear the angels sing so beautiful.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I saw a light at the end of the tunnel and before I knew it I was standing there in heaven.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm THE EXPERIENCE ITSELF WAS DISTINCTIVE AND IT WAS A DIMENSIONS ONE I FEEL THAT VERY FEW CAN EXPERIENCE.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Something so beautiful that you just can't explain. It's a peaceful wonderful feeling. It's a yearning I have within me to return one day. The day God has planned for me. It's a feeling that you just don't want to come back!
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I strongly now believe that God can see us very well and that heaven does exist.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The peace, the whole experience. Only others who have experienced an out of body can relate to the beauty of such a voyage.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Well I felt a peace, a sense of belonging.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes The same day. Wow! That's incredible. Others have also testified that they too have had a similar experience.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. Well it was like when you've taken a vacation and had a great time. You saw things you never saw before. However, it's engraved in your mind therefore your remember very well your experience. And know that the place exists, because you visited.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. It's like your spirit who is a living thing. Left my body and in returning you absolutely know that you had a voyage out of your body.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I just want to thank you for this website in which I got to read experiences of others!
